notes.title: Update to v1.8.5 - Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

This update is porting United Assault - Normandy '44 to Unreal Engine 5, is adding Ray Tracing support and does improve on various aspects of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/fb8cf3b6aa2db4378996c060cce862b06a2e3120.png[/img]

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/1e5028f1e91364a0961f3503b9cda075d0b281e2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] updated to Unreal Engine 5.1
[*] updated DLSS version
[*] updated vehicles to use Chaos Physics Engine
[*] updated weapon pickups
[*] updated game files for future updates
[/list]

[h2][b]Important Informations[/b][/h2]
We started an update progress to Unreal Engine 5 a while ago and abandoned it because of the sheer number of bugs and issues the upgrade brought with it. This time it took us roughly a month to get the game fully working on UE5 with a lot of bugs fixed early on. However there is a potential this update brought with it new until unnoticed bugs we did not catch. Please report all bugs so we are able to fix them!

The game was not designed around Ray Tracing, which means especially interiours can be to dark at certain weather conditions. We are aware of this and want to correct this with future updates!

[h2][b]Savegames and Progression[/b][/h2]
The update to Unreal Engine 5 forced us to rework savegame compatibility. This means with this update Settings and Progressions are reset. There is a way to recover your old progression but this might cause game crashes.

[b]Recovering Progress at your own risk:[/b]
[list]
[*] Open the folder [i]C:\Users\DUsername\AppData\Local\UnitedAssault\Saved\SaveGames[/i]
[*] Create a subfolder called [i]Normandy[/i] if it does not already exist
[*] Copy the file [i]Normandy_Progression.sav[/i] into the new [i]Normandy[/i] Subfolder
[/list]

[h2][b]Playing the legacyUnreal Engine 4 game (v1.1.0)[/b][/h2]
The old Unreal Engine 4 version of the game is available [i]legacy[/i] branch.

notes.title: The future of United Assault
notes.content:
It is again time to look into the future of United Assault. Here is what you can expect in the coming weeks and months!

[h2]United Assault - Next[/h2]
The next and final installment of the United Assault Trilogy is currently in development. We won't sahre any details on this project yet. We just want you to know a new Title is in development and will introduce new features which will again be patched intho Normandy '44 and Battle of the Bulge.

[h2]United Assault - Battle of the Bulge[/h2]
We have collected a lot of feedback on Battle of the Bulge and decided we are going a different route then with Normandy '44! There will be no map expansion and rather a map enhancement. We will add more details, locations and improvements into the existing map. Besides this Battle of the Bluge will recieve Feature and Weapon updates from United Assault - Next.

The Playstation 4, Xbox One and Xbox Series versions are in certification and will release this year!

[h2]United Assault - Normandy '44[/h2]
Normandy '44 will continue to recieve bug fix updates and after the launch of United Assault - Next, it will get some new weapon unlocks.

[h2]Unreal Engine 5[/h2]
We have spent a lot of time in the past weeks to check the possibilities of a Unreal Engine 5 update. The game is partly working on the new engine but we decided to cancel this effort. The switch to UE5 would mean larger reworks which would end the compatibility to already released Console versions. Meaning there would never be any update to those versions ever again. And this is a step we won't take.

notes.title: Update to v1.7.5
notes.content:
[b]This is a minor update targeting performance issues on lower end systems. [/b]

United Assault - Normandy '44 now tracks the performance on your system and if it will ever run below 25 FPS it will track down the source and tries to free up some resources on runtime. If the framedrop happens to be CPU related, the game will temporarly disable several AI features (Hearing, Cover generator) until the game runs again at at least 30 FPS. If the performance drop is GPU related, impact particles, muzzle flashes and other minor visual features will be temporarly disabled until the game runs at at least 30 FPS again. 

This will not have any impact if you are running the game with higher framerates and is intended to improve the playability on low end systems.

We also increased the max Rank to 40 and overhauled the vehicle physics.

notes.title: Roadmap 2022 | Co-op , PvP and more!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Welcome to the Roadmap for 2022![/h2][/b]
United Assault - Normandy '44 has come a long way and it's far from over! We are planning to release several major updates across the year. And here is how it's going to happen.

[h2]Battle of the Bulge[/h2]
As announced last year, we'll developing a standalone expansion called Battle of the Bulge.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625340/United_Assault__Battle_of_the_Bulge/

This is with the port of Normandy '44 to Playstation 4 and 5 is currently the highest priority.
This means updates for Normandy '44 will slow down for a while. and will katch up again once we start adding in some of the new features and improvements from Battle of the Bulge.

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
Yes, United Assault is getting a full multiplayer part, if you want to have it! For now, this will be for PC only and might come to consoles at a later point. The Multiplayer will be a standalone game which will be unlocked for free to owners of the base United Assault games (Normandy '44 or Battle of the Bulge) or will be made available as a seperate purchase.

This will ensure that the players are not split between several games and can play together as one big community.

[b]This is the business model[/b]:
United Assault Multiplayer is a Buy-to-Play game without lootboxes or an ingame store. The Multiplayer in base contains the weapons and Maps of Normandy '44. By owning Battle of the Bulge, you will get the Battle of the Bulge map and weepons unlocked for free in the Multiplayer, if you don't own Battle of the Bulge, you can buy the gameworld and weapons as a DLC.

[h3]Co-op[/h3]
the main focus of United Assault Multiplayer will be Co-op gameplay. The coop will use the full gameworld of Normandy '44 as a base with predefined Co-op Missions and randomly generated missions to choose. The Battle of the Bulge map will be made available at a later date for owners of Battle of the Bulge or the DLC owners.

[h3]PvP[/h3]
We will also add a small PvP mode into the game which right now is Team Deathmatch only but more modes can be added during development. This mode will use parts of the gameworlds as PvP maps and is entirly unlocked. This means in PvP you don't need to buy anything additionally to get new maps and weapons.

[h3]Release[/h3]
When it's done! We are targeting summer 2022 to unlock it to owners of Normandy '44 and Battle of the Bulge as a form of pre access. A real Early Access release might come in fall 2022, depending on feedback.

You are tasked to infiltrate enemy territory and locate, infiltrate and destroy one of germany's secret V2 factories in the Ardennes. This preview is soly focused on optimization and loading times. It does contain several smaller bug fixes and improvements but this is currently not the focus.

We know that loading times can sometimes be long in this game, even on older and slower hard drives. We took the time to modify the engine and implemented a new compression algorithm, which is as efficient as the old one, but a lot faster at decompressing data. We also modified the asynchronous level loading and asset organization.

This in total can improve loading times significantly and under the right condition can cut the loading times in half.

[h1]FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions[/h1]

[b]1) Will the Gameworld get expanded?[/b]
Yes! We try to add at least one new location with each major update!

[b]2) Will there be new Weapons?[/b]
Yes! Some of them are already listed on the [url=https://trello.com/b/zPdWY9Fw/united-assault-roadmap]Roadmap[/url] and some will remain a secret until they are available.

[b]3) How often will the game be updated?[/b]
We try to update the game at least once a week. But as Game Development is not 100% predictable and some bug can be nasty to track down, it might stretch sometimes a bit further.

[b]3) Will the game be released on other Systems?[/b]
Yes! The game is coming to Xbox, Nintendo Switch and Playstation later this year!

[b]4) What should I expect from this game at Early Access start?[/b]
Expect a Alpha version. No Marketing Alpha, a real Alpha! The gameworld in incomplete, some sounds and textures are missing and some features (like the UI/Menu) are incomplete. It is playable, you can unlock new Weapons and play the game in a compressed version. Expect Bugs, crashes and glitches. That's why it's launched in Early Access. Report your ideas and feedback and we will try to adress them!

[b]5) Is the passive Multiplayer available at launch?[/b]
Yes and No. The game can and will establish a connection to the server and will send required informations. However the Server does currently only store the data to build up a database but not send back any data. This will be enabled in a later update.

[b]6) Does the passive multiplayer collect personal data?[/b]
No! It just shares informations of Gameplay statistics, Kills, Headshots, Objectives completed and so on. Other then gameplay related data,nothing is transferred.

[b]7) Do I need an additional account for Passive Multiplayer?[/b]
No! You only need to have Steam running in the background and that's it!

Do you have another question? Let us know!
